title: Erin
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 15 dumbbell split cleans with 40/30 lb dumbbells and 21 pull-ups. Honours Canadian Army Master Cpl. Erin Doyle, killed in a firefight in Kandahar Province, Afghanistan, in 2008. Alternate the lead leg on the split cleans.
